profile.title: Frontend Developer
profile.bio: I'm a 19-year-old frontend developer based in Agadir, Morocco, currently studying at EWA School. I love crafting smooth, performant interfaces and building tools that make people's work easier.

projects.name: Task Flow
projects.description: A clean, minimal task manager with focus mode, keyboard shortcuts, and local persistence. Built for people who think faster than they type.

projects.name: Code Arena
projects.description: A real-time coding battleground where developers solve challenges head-to-head. Live cursors, instant feedback, and a leaderboard that actually feels rewarding.

projects.name: Portfolio v1
projects.description: My first portfolio — a single-page site that introduced me to the web. Simple, fast, and honest. The starting line for everything that came after.
